summary: Confirmed $38-50 for 2 guests (+$4.99 per reservation), 20/30/50A full hookups, pull-throughs; sites 18 -> 39; military discount (directory only) cleared; operator calls RV01-12 riverview (stored not waterfront - re-audit lead).
flags: PRIVATE GATES: posted nightly $38 (water/electric, 51-58 ft grass pads a 23-ft rig fits) to $50 (riverview pull-throughs) for 2 guests, dynamic pricing - passes at $50 or under. The $4.99 fee is per reservation, not nightly. Gateway: none within 40 km (Branson 143 km). Good Sam: stored false (directory, derived) - operator silent, left. Presence: operator site with phone +1 (573) 765-3044 and its own booking cart. REVIEWS: Google Maps 4.8 stars, 348 reviews; RV Life 4.5, 35 reviews, $$.

LONG-STAY: the camping page markets 'SEASONAL SITES (Recreational Only) May - September' and 'Extended STAYS Year Round - Weekly, Bi-Weekly and Monthly Rates'. (1) price $38-50 - pass; (2) nightly rates posted and sold online - pass; (3) no minimum stated on the pages read - pass as far as read; (4) one-night occupancy NOT checked: the book-now page's availability map (R2M2 Map Pro plugin) rendered blank in the headless browser and showed no availability calls, so I could not count open sites for two future weeknights; (5) not a home community - pass. It reads as a float/transient resort with a seasonal side, not a long-stay park, but test 4 is unread.

WATERFRONT RE-AUDIT LEAD (contrary operator claim; value not changed): stored 'not waterfront', but the operator sells RV01-RV12 as 'Premium with Riverview'. Imagery: the southern row of pads sits ~25-40 m north of the Gasconade (~35-40 m of water, a river), with the campground's own loop road and a thin tree band between them, so riverview is plausible ('*view at best' because of the road); not waterfront on the far row.
